name: Custom task
summary: Give your agent a mission in your own words.

prompt:
Research or discuss this question with the human:
{{input}}

Lead with a direct answer, then explain the evidence, open questions, and useful next steps.
Read referenced sources and link to evidence. Distinguish verified facts from assumptions.
Ask a focused clarification when needed and make space for follow-up questions.
This is a conversation: do not implement changes, post reviews, or merge PRs unless explicitly asked.
name: Chat
summary: Research a question or think something through together.

prompt:
Implement this request:
{{input}}

Read the requirements and any linked context. Explore the project and follow its conventions.
Plan and implement a focused change, then run the relevant checks.
Use a feature branch, commit and push the completed change, and open a draft pull request.
Link the original request when applicable. Report the result, validation, and any remaining limitations.
If requirements or necessary access are unclear, ask the user rather than guessing.
name: Implement
summary: Turn a ticket or a mission into tested code and a draft pull request.

prompt:
Address feedback and merge these pull requests:
{{input}}

Identify the complete requested scope, including linked discussions, and check each PR's current state.
For dependent PRs, work in dependency order. Ask the user if the repository or scope is unclear.
Read the review threads, implement applicable feedback on the existing branch, and resolve conflicts.
Run relevant checks, push the fixes, and reply to each addressed comment. Explain feedback that cannot be applied.
Investigate failing CI without skipping or weakening tests.
Merge only after required checks and approvals pass on the latest commit, using the project's normal method.
Do not bypass branch protections. Report each PR's final state and any blockers.
Keep discussion on the PRs; do not post messages or reactions elsewhere unless the user asks.
name: Resolve & merge
summary: Address feedback, resolve conflicts, and get one or multiple PRs green and merged.

prompt:
Review these pull requests:
{{input}}

Identify the complete requested scope and check each PR's current state. Ask if the repository or scope is unclear.
Read the description, linked requirements, existing review threads, current diff, and relevant check results.
For stacked PRs, compare each against its own target branch to avoid duplicate findings.
Follow the project's review conventions. Check correctness, maintainability, and test coverage.
Verify findings against the latest revision and post actionable comments or suggestions on the relevant PR.
Avoid duplicating existing feedback. Approve only when authorized and no unresolved blocking findings remain.
Do not change the author's code, push commits, or merge as part of the review.
Post comments only on the PRs. Do not comment on Jira or other issue-tracker tickets, even if general
project instructions request progress updates. Linked tickets may be read for context.
Do not send messages or add reactions elsewhere unless the user asks.
Report the reviewed PRs, links to posted feedback, and any access or validation limitations.
name: Review PR
summary: Review one or multiple PRs and post actionable feedback on each.

prompt:
Fix the failing checks for this target:
{{input}}

Identify the relevant branch or pull request and inspect the failing logs.
Reproduce the failure where possible and fix the root cause, following the project's conventions.
Do not skip or weaken tests to get a passing result. Explain unrelated failures or unavailable checks.
Run relevant checks, commit and push the fix on the appropriate branch, and verify the resulting CI status.
Report what changed, what passed, and anything still blocked.
name: Fix CI
summary: Investigate failing checks, fix the cause, and get CI green.

name: Ask for review
summary: Prepare pull requests and request review from the right people.
prompt:
Prepare these pull requests and request review:
{{input}}

Identify the PRs, their current state, and the project's contribution and review conventions.
Check for unresolved conflicts, failing required checks, and outstanding feedback. Report blockers before requesting review.
Mark draft PRs ready only when they meet the project's readiness requirements.
Use the reviewers and communication destination specified by the user or the project's instructions.
If the destination or reviewers are unclear, ask the user. Do not guess channels, teams, or recipients.
Send a concise request with a brief description and a link to each PR. Follow the destination's formatting conventions.
Verify the request and links, then report where review was requested.

name: Technical discovery
summary: Research an initiative and propose an actionable implementation plan.
prompt:
Research and plan this initiative:
{{input}}

This is discovery, not implementation. Do not change code, create branches, or open pull requests.
Clarify the goal, scope, assumptions, and success criteria. Read relevant project documentation and existing work.
Map the current implementation with evidence, including affected components, dependencies, and constraints.
Compare practical approaches and recommend one, explaining trade-offs, risks, compatibility, testing, and rollout.
Break the work into cohesive, independently reviewable steps with acceptance criteria and dependencies.
Identify unknowns and propose focused investigations where needed.
Present the plan and open questions for review. Create or update tracker items only after the user approves
the plan and destination. Follow that project's conventions and verify any saved items.
